title: Corpus size deliberately changed from 21 to 22 sessions -- sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec included by explicit user decision. Registries regenerated; fig03 re-verification in progress.
note: Direct consequence of the fig03-omission-reporter-v2-criteria-20260811.json classifier run, which globs the NWB directory rather than filtering to the catalog and so picked up the previously-uncatalogued 22nd session automatically. Asked the user explicitly whether to restore 21, adopt 22, or defer -- answer: adopt 22 as the corpus going forward.

claims.statement: artifacts/data/nwb_catalog.json and artifacts/data/session_readiness.csv were regenerated via their own canonical scripts (scripts/build_nwb_catalog.py, scripts/build_session_readiness.py) rather than hand-edited, per the project's 'registries go stale silently' doctrine -- both now report 22 sessions/files, correctly including sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec. A metadata sidecar (probe_areas.json etc.) was also built for this session (previously missing, since it predated the earlier sidecar-rebuild pass this session which used the then-21-session catalog) via scripts/archive_oneoff/build_session_sidecars.py --session 230629.
claims.receipt: scripts/build_nwb_catalog.py output: 'wrote artifacts\data\nwb_catalog.json n_files=22'. scripts/build_session_readiness.py output: 'wrote artifacts\data\session_readiness.csv n=22'. Sidecar build: 'sidecar sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec <- sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec.nwb, electrodes=256 units=464 events=4163 areas=[V1,V2,V3a,V3d]'.

claims.statement: CLAUDE.md and .agents/AGENTS.md both carried a now-stale '21 sessions' figure and a stale pre-2026-08-08-migration TFR array path (D:/workspace/data/tfr_arrays/); both updated in place with the corpus-size change and a pointer to re-verify rather than quote either stale number, consistent with the doctrine's own 'registries/manifests go stale silently' rule.
claims.receipt: CLAUDE.md line ~14 area, .agents/AGENTS.md lines ~28-37, this session's edits.

claims.statement: outputs/classification/omission_grand_units.csv (fig03's source table, produced by the same classifier run that added omission_class_v2) now reflects 22 sessions, 9,056 units (up from 21/8,592) -- confirmed by the classifier's own receipt.json. fig03_unit_census.py was re-run against this table 2026-08-11 to re-verify denominators at the new corpus size before this figure is considered current; NOT YET independently visually reviewed by the user (same rule as fig03-closure-verification-20260811.json's re-lock gate -- unaffected by this corpus change).

The legacy S+/S- classifier table (outputs/classification/grand_s_and_o_units.csv), which feeds fig03's MAIN figure panels A-F via the 'legacy_screened' population, was NOT regenerated as part of this change and does not cover the 22nd session -- it still covers the same 15 of (now 22) sessions it always did. Expectation: fig03's main-figure denominator (2,921) should be UNAFFECTED by the corpus-size change; only the presence/peak-rate supplement (which uses the full grand table, 8,592 -> 9,056) should change. This is stated as an expectation pending the fig03 re-run's own denominator check (see falsifier).
claims.receipt: context/figures/fig03_unit_census/README.md's existing description of grand_s_and_o_units.csv's independent 15-session scope, unchanged by this session's work.

issues: TFR-array corpus rebuild (fig05/fig06) was launched against the OLD 21-session metadata sidecar set and is partway through as of this corpus-size decision -- the 22nd session's TFR arrays have not been generated and are not in that job's queue (the driver script's session list was fixed at launch time, before this sidecar was built). Needs a follow-up run for sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec specifically once the main TFR rebuild finishes, tracked under the Fig06 task.

The v2 omission-reporter criteria (omission_class_v2) still needs its statistical design fixed (peak-over-many-bins null is underpowered, see the v2 criteria node's open issue) before any comparison numbers from it should be trusted -- unaffected by this corpus-size decision but noting both are open in the same table.
falsifier: Superseded once fig03's re-render (in progress) is checked panel-by-panel the same way the original closure pass was -- confirming the main-figure denominator stays 2,921 (unaffected) and the supplement denominator becomes 9,056 (not 8,592), with no other panel drift.
falsifier_status: CLOSED -- confirmed 2026-08-11 via SVG <text> extraction (glyph-path <use> refs are not literal text; literal <text> elements were parsed and cross-summed) against the clean RNG-fixed 22-session, 9,056-unit run. Main figure (legacy-screened): S++(729)+S+(130)+S-(134)+S--(338)+O-(73)+O--(1)+O+(73)+O++(3)+Other(1440) = 2,921 exactly, unchanged from the 21-session render. Supplement presence panel: per-area n's sum to 8,702 (matches stated evaluable 8,702/9,056; stable 2,611 + unstable 1,836 + mua 4,255 = 8,702). Supplement peak-rate panel: per-area n's sum to 9,056 exactly (matches evaluable 9,056/9,056; slow 1,298 + moderate-slow 2,749 + moderate 2,965 + moderate-fast 1,773 + fast 271 = 9,056). No other panel drift found. Per REVISION_PLAN.md rule 4, this closes the corpus-size-change verification only -- fig03 re-lock (fig03_finalized.*) still requires the user's own visual confirmation, same open gate as fig03-closure-verification-20260811.json.
